comments.body: There is a typo here! `self.aweight0` is initialised but used `self.weight0`. Shouldn't this be self.aweight0 to avoid attribute error?
comments.diff_hunk:
@@ -60,7 +63,9 @@ def __init__(self, xcstr: str, nnmodel: torch.nn.Module, aweight0: float = 0.0):
         self.xcstr = xcstr
         self.nnmodel = nnmodel
         self.aweight0 = aweight0
-        self.hybridxc = HybridXC(self.xcstr, self.nnmodel, aweight0=aweight0)
+        self.hybridxc = HybridXC(self.xcstr,
+                                 self.nnmodel,
+                                 aweight0=self.weight0)
